text:
claire: Quick sync — working on 'AnchorRoll' plan for private distro upgrades + customer-managed networking. Goal: make upgrades predictable for field teams and clear network ownership boundaries. Need minimal GA checklist and tradeoffs.

zhen: Can we reuse the existing handshake API for owner discovery? or do we add new metadata? @claire

matt: Important: airgapped customers can't hit control plane. We'll need offline delta bundles + a way to apply patches locally. +1 to a preflight check.

sophie: Customer ask: preserve IPs during upgrade for peered networks. Also want a one-command dry-run for net ops.

claire: Draft GA checklist idea (proposal):
1) delta/offline installer + checksums
2) network-owner metadata + audit trail
3) simple preflight: redwoodctl verify-network --dry-run
4) phased rollout: canary -> ramp -> full, with pinned model versions
5) rollback/fallback path to hosted-compatible model variant
6) ops runbook + 15m target upgrade window

zhen: For (2) propose owner tags and route-priority field. Example annotation style: owner=netops@example.com, owner_role=network-owner, route_priority=100

matt: Implementation notes: agent should accept "offline_bundle.tar.gz" and a small manifest. Example manifest we can use in prototype (pseudo):
```json
{
  "version":"2026-03-01",
  "components":["agent","runtime","models"],
  "patches":[{"file":"delta1.bin","sha256":"..."}]
}
```
We'll keep manifest minimal to avoid complex parsers.

sophie: UX for field: 
- single-liner: `redwoodctl upgrade --bundle ./anchorroll.tar.gz --dry-run`
- verbose logs to file for support: `--log /tmp/upgrade.log`
Please add explicit guidance for peering IP preservation.

claire: Edge cases: multiple network owners in same tenant -> need explicit owner resolution rules (prefer per-subnet owner, fallback to tenant-level). Also add conflict detection in preflight.

zhen: I'll spec owner-tagging + resolution rules (EOD Tue). Will include examples and validations for route_priority ranges.

matt: I'll prototype delta installer and offline bundle flow this week; will try to keep bundle size minimised and produce a sample CLI flow.

sophie: I'll draft the ops runbook, including customer-facing checklist and rollback steps. Aim to have a customer review-ready draft by Wed.

claire: Action items recap: @zhen spec owner tags; @matt prototype delta installer; @sophie ops runbook + customer checklist. I'll consolidate and schedule a 30m customer review Wed afternoon. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Created doc for agenda: https://docs.redwood.ai/anchorroll (permissions: product + field)

matt: one more ask — include an explicit test harness for peering in our QA envs. can we schedule a quick test window next Thurs?

claire: Yes — will add QA slot to the agenda. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
